name: Gulf International Services Q.P.S.C.
summary: Gulf International Services Q.P.S.C., through its subsidiaries, provides insurance and reinsurance, helicopter transportation, and drilling and related services in Qatar, Turkiye, and internationally. It operates through Drilling, Aviation, and Insurance segments. The company owns and operates offshore and onshore drilling rigs that are used for drilling wells for oil and natural gas extraction, as well as jack-up accommodation barges and lift boats.
